description_en: Unaca Bhājubala Bāhāḥ is located in Nyākhā Cuka, east of the Bhāskaravarṇa Vihāra (LAL0860). It is unclear how the Bāhāḥ got its name.Although it is abāhāḥ, it lacks akvāḥpāḥchẽ. The statue of Akṣobhya attached to one of the threeśikharakūṭa caityas (LAL0861-002) is worshipped as the main deity of the Bāhāḥ. The statue is a part of the Triratna, the three gems formation of the Buddha, the Dharma and the Saṃgha. There are threeśikharakūṭa caityas, twodharmadhātu caityas, and onedharmadhātujinālaya caityaat the Bāhāḥ's premises.There is a lack of inscriptive evidence to point to its initial construction. Theśikharakūṭa caitya(LAL0861-004) was constructed in NS 776 (1656 CE) by Jinadeva Vajrācārya.A Vajrācārya family from Nyākhā Cuka performs the daily rituals here. Its anniversary takes place on the 1stof the dark fortnight of Bhādra.
description_ne: न्याखा चुकमा रहेको भाष्करवर्ण महाविहार (LAL0860) को पूर्वतिर उनच भाजुबल बाहा: रहेको छ । यो बाहा:को नाम उनच भाजुबल किन राखियो भन्ने कुरा स्पष्ट छैन । यो बाहा: भएपनि यहाँ कुनै क्वा:पा:छेँ बनाइएको छैन । शिखरकूट चैत्य (LAL0861-002) सँगै टाँस्सिएर राखिएको त्रिरत्न (बुद्ध-धर्म-संघ) को मूर्तिमा रहेको अक्षोभ्यलाई नै मुख्य देवता मानी पूजा गरिन्छ ।यो बाहा: वरिपरि तीनवटा शिखरकूट चैत्य, दुईवटा धर्मधातु मण्डल र एउटा धर्मधातुजिनालय चैत्य रहेका छन् । यो बाहा:को निर्माणबारे कुनै ऐतिहासिक प्रमाण पाइएको छैन । बाहा: परिसरमा रहेको शिखरकूट चैत्य (LAL0861-004) नेसं ७७६ (सन् १६५६) मा वज्राचार्य जिनदेवले निर्माण गरेका थिए ।यो बाहा:मा न्याखा चुकमा बस्ने एक वज्राचार्य परिवारले नित्यपूजा गरिरहेको छ । प्रत्येक वर्ष भाद्र कृष्ण प्रतिपदाका दिन बाहा:को वर्षवर्द्धनपूजा गरिन्छ ।

historical_events.event_description: Rājabhāi Vajrācārya, his wife Lakṣmī Vajrācārya and other family members jointly offered 21 praying wheels to four Caityas and two Dharmadhātu Maṇḍalas in the memory of their deceased parents Buddharatna Vajrācārya and Bekhāmāyā Vajrācārya.
Vajrācārya Jinadeva and his wife Vimalā together with their children constructed the Śikharakūṭa Caitya. They also endowed some plots of land to perform worship.
